The pièce de résistance is the giant aluminum pan bubbling with hot oil, emitting a savory aroma that teases the senses and beckons you to come and indulge. The entire scene is nestled beneath a shady canopy of trees, right next to the brick path and the calm lake, creating a serene ambiance that's perfect for a leisurely afternoon or a romantic evening.
